response.content: The issue lies in the logic for checking if the sum can be made congruent to C modulo B. We need to consider that any multiple of A can be added to itself repeatedly, so we should check if there exists a non-negative integer k such that (k * A) % B == C. This can be simplified to checking if C is within the set of multiples of A modulo B.
